answer.instructions: Which team should handle this support ticket for an online shop?

criteria.billing: Charges, invoices, refunds, payment methods and subscription fees
criteria.technical: The website or app is broken: errors, crashes, or pages and features not working
criteria.account: Signing in, passwords, email address, profile details, security and closing an account
criteria.shipping: Delivery of an order: tracking, delays, address changes, missing or damaged parcels
criteria.feature_request: A suggestion for something new the shop or app does not offer yet

items.state: The checkout said 15% off with the SPRING code but my receipt shows I paid full price. Can you credit me the difference?
items.label: billing

items.state: I'd love a way to get an alert when an item in my size comes back in stock.
items.label: feature_request

items.state: I get 'Error 500' when I try to add anything to my basket. Pls fix, I want to buy a gift today.
items.label: technical

items.state: Please delete my account and all my personal data. I don't want to shop here anymore.
items.label: account

items.state: The discount code box disappeared from checkout in the iPhone app. It's still there on the website.
items.label: technical

items.state: Product photos aren't loading on your website, I just see grey boxes everywhere since this morning.
items.label: technical

items.state: Only 2 of the 3 items in my order arrived. The packing slip lists all three.
items.label: shipping

items.label: account

items.state: Search is broken - typing 'running shoes' returns zero results even though you sell running shoes.
items.label: technical

items.label: feature_request

items.state: Hi, I was charged twice for order 48213. My bank shows two payments of $62.40 on the same day. Please refund one of them.
items.label: billing

items.state: Do you ship to Iceland, and how long would delivery take?
items.label: shipping

items.state: Your app sends me the same wishlist notification every 5 minutes. I tried to turn it off in settings but the toggle doesn't save.
items.label: technical

items.state: Can you add a size guide in centimetres? Only inches is confusing for us in Europe.
items.label: feature_request

items.state: Someone signed into my account from another country last night. Please lock it, that wasn't me.
items.label: account

items.state: i want to change the name on my profile, i got married and my surname is diffrent now
items.label: account

items.state: Can the courier leave my parcel with the building reception? I'm at work all day.
items.label: shipping

items.label: shipping

items.label: shipping

items.label: account

items.state: It would be great if I could save more than one delivery address in my account.
items.label: feature_request

items.state: I cancelled my plan in March but you charged me again on April 1st. I want that charge reversed please.
items.label: billing

items.state: I typed the wrong house number on order 51907. It hasn't shipped yet - can you change it to 14 instead of 41?
items.label: shipping

items.state: Would you consider adding gift wrapping as an option at checkout?

items.state: The size filter on the women's boots page doesn't do anything. I pick 39 and it still shows every size.

items.state: I need a VAT invoice for my last three orders for my company accounts. The receipt in my email doesn't show your tax number.
items.label: billing

items.label: billing
